formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: Email and postal delivery require human release selection, asset inspection, rights confirmation and a choice of exactly one delivery method.

activityVerification.evidence: KAOS published Top 30 charts through June 22, 2026, maintains a populated current staff page with a Music Director and assistants, provides schedule, playlist and live-stream surfaces, and posted 2026 station events and programming updates.

genreFitEvidence: KAOS is a freeform station whose independent-music policy requires 80% of played music to come from outside major labels.
Current 2026 charts and programming span electronic, experimental, world, hip-hop, funk, alternative and other independent formats.
A coherent clean MarcsMusic electronic, world-fusion, reggae-adjacent, ambient or experimental EP/album has plausible fit, subject to human release selection.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The route is first-party and fee-free as published, but it excludes singles, prioritizes physical media, limits digital delivery to links without attachments, enforces a no-safe-harbor content standard, and leaves international eligibility, technical download requirements, rights, release timing and AI-origin rules unresolved.
